source.name: Mutopia Project
source.reference: Mutopia-2015/08/18-931; Breitkopf & Härtel, 1888; typeset by Stelios Samelis. Complete piece, including both marked repeats and their alternate endings, through the final A-minor cadence and rest. Eighth-note pickup; 187.5 quarter notes in the performed sequence. Grace-note demo timing: F4 and A4 each last 30 ticks (one quarter of their written sixteenths), borrowed from the preceding right-hand chord. The B-flat4 appoggiatura occupies the first 30 ticks of its principal A4, which is delayed and shortened by 30 ticks. Measure lengths and other voices are unchanged. Demo tempo: quarter note = 72 BPM (Mutopia MIDI setting). Nested ornament lengths preserve this demo interpretation; borrowed time is applied only when generating playback events.
